description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin.
name: Jellyfin Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog:
Combined build of [Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream](https://github.com/Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream) with open upstream PRs:

- #301 Support Jellyfin 12 (targets net10.0, ABI 12.0.0.0)
- #302 Fix series, seasons and movies lost to unexpected provider data
- #299 External XMLTV EPG support for Live TV channels

Plugin repository: `https://vandernorth.github.io/Jellyfin.Xtream/repository.json`

Thanks to Kevin Jilissen, achevalet and Emerald-Railroad for the original work.
